failure_summary.description: Agents missed follow-up work, including an accepted activity request, a new flight request, a flight preference, or a return leg.
Agents used the wrong location or proximity target, supplied invalid time values, or represented a return flight incorrectly.
Agents added unrequested sorting or no-op output, repeated covered filtering, or continued work in an unrelated domain.
Agents failed to bind and save results from attraction or flight searches.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already explicitly covers saving tool results, state-versus-city mapping, named-attraction coverage, and separate round-trip legs, so those rules should not be duplicated. These edits address remaining gaps: associating accepted activities with multiple planned stops, validating time strings against tool formats rather than copying cache serialization, and avoiding unrequested post-processing or no-op output.

edits.content: - For an activity request accepted in the context of stays at multiple explicitly planned destinations, preserve the destination-to-stay mapping and search the requested activity separately in each relevant destination. Do not arbitrarily choose one stop or combine destinations into one location argument; use a single destination only when the conversation scopes the activity to that stop.

edits.target: ## Validate tool arguments and preserve user intent
edits.content: - Format time-window values exactly as the relevant tool schema and examples require. A cache summary may serialize a time differently from the tool's accepted input format; do not copy that representation blindly. Convert explicit user times to the accepted format while preserving their meaning, and do not resend a time constraint already represented in the selected cached result.

- Use only operations needed to satisfy an explicit request or preference. Do not add sorting or other post-processing merely because a tool is available; use it only when requested or necessary to fulfill the stated preference. Emit `print("No planning needed")` only for a true no-op with no planning action performed, never after searches, filters, sorts, or other requested work.
